title: SS27 Kids' Season Colour Analysis
summary: Bright, saturated summer colour returns to kidswear, led by red, aqua and lemon, balanced by soft pastels and calm neutrals.

sections.heading: The palette
sections.body:
| Colour | Pantone TCX (nearest) | HEX | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lemon | 12-0642 TCX | #EDDD59 | Seasonal |
| Aqua | 14-4816 TCX | #58C9D4 | Seasonal |
| Grass green | 16-0237 TCX | #75A14F | Seasonal |
| Coral | 16-1541 TCX | #F6745F | Seasonal |
| Lavender | 14-3812 TCX | #BDB0D0 | Seasonal |
| Sand | 13-1009 TCX | #DAC7AB | Core |
| Red | 18-1664 TCX | #D01C1F | Accent, newly strong |
| Navy | 19-3920 TCX | #2B2E43 | Core |

The first six are Forecut's SS27 kidswear palette<sup>[1]</sup>; red and navy are added from the June trade fairs<sup>[2]</sup>. Confirm codes against a physical Pantone book before dyeing.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- **Red:** "one of the defining colors of the season" at Playtime Paris, from bright statement shades to deeper tones<sup>[2]</sup>.
- **Navy and nautical:** sailor collars and navy blues throughout Playtime Paris<sup>[2]</sup>.
- **Colour overall:** Pitti Bimbo called its June edition "the most colorful summer edition yet"<sup>[3]</sup>; Pisamonas' SS27 shoes arrive "full of color"<sup>[4]</sup>; Poco Blush showed bold hues for girls<sup>[5]</sup>.
- **Soft pastels:** Piccoli Principi's "Pearl & Tides" runs from vintage pink to pastel green and soft navy<sup>[4]</sup>.
- **Neutrals:** Fatamadrina notes "neutrals enhanced with terracotta and sage green" alongside bright, saturated colours<sup>[6]</sup>.

sections.heading: Colour groups
sections.body:
- **Core:** navy, sand, white.
- **Seasonal brights:** lemon, aqua, coral, grass green.
- **Seasonal soft:** lavender, vintage pink, pastel green.
- **Accent:** red.

sections.heading: By age
sections.body:
- **Baby and toddler:** soft pastels and sand, with one bright accent.
- **Kids:** brights with navy and white.
- **Older kids and teens:** red, navy and stripes; lavender for girls who want softer colour.

timing: Red is rising for SS27; brights return after several pastel-led seasons. Soft pastels stay core for baby.
products: - Red: tees, sandals, accessories. Aqua and lemon: swim and play. Lavender: dresses and knits. Navy and sand: bottoms and basics.
design_implications:
- Lab-dip brights on both jersey and swim fabric; they shift between substrates.
- Check colour fastness to chlorinated and salt water for swim.
commercial_implications: - Navy and sand carry volume; brights and red carry newness.
